catalogueTitle: "Can I switch hotels? My partner is joining."
demoRole: Accommodation modification, cancellation rules, personal/business cost attribution, local routing
note: Hannah Weiss (ait-draft-31, FRA origin) is the Rhein Hotels CCO and a dual-interview speaker (hospitality-interview, 1 Oct 10:30, REQUIRED/FIXED, alongside ait-draft-22). Her partner (a non-participant - no roster entry, no traveller entity is created for them) is joining for the summit dates, and she asks to move from her Bayview single to a double junior suite at the alternative partner hotel Harbourline, keeping the same nights (30 Sep - 3 Oct check-out; her return MN242 flies 3 Oct 23:45). This is the catalogue shape 'switch hotel because partner is joining': current cancellation terms (free until 27 Sep), replacement rates vs the SGD 320 ceiling, second-occupant/upgrade increment traveller-funded (clauses.companionAndUpgradeIncrement requires an explicit funding declaration), event-vs-personal attribution, venue travel time and morning event buffers (Harbourline->MBS shuttle vs Bayview). Note the schema nuance: rule-ait-hotel-funded-window names place-hotel-bayview only; Harbourline is admissible via clauses.accommodationCeiling preferredPlaces - the pack records this rather than papering over it. Companion ontology is deliberately NOT added (catalogue MVP boundary); the companion is carried as declared cost data only. Simulated seam: room/seat inventory is SIMULATED_EXTERNAL_EVENT; at demo runtime the same shapes arrive via REPLAY.

affectedTravellers.reason: Junior suite at Harbourline (SGD 318/night) is under the SGD 320 ceiling; Bayview booking can be released free of charge before 27 Sep 15:00; morning buffers for the 1 Oct 10:30 interview remain satisfied (shuttle 15m expected / 25m conservative vs Bayview's 12m / 20m). Event funds only the business-equivalent single room (SGD 285/night); the double-occupancy increment (SGD 33/night x 3) and the whole companion seat are traveller-funded per the explicit funding declaration.

expectedReasoningHooks: Accommodation modification with cancellation reasoning: check the Bayview block terms first (free modification until 27 Sep 15:00; request arrives 19 Sep -> no penalty) before proposing anything.

Ceiling enforcement against replacement rates: junior suite 318 passes rule-ait-hotel-spend-limit (320); the one-bedroom suite 355 fails it and would need rule-ait-approval-above-hotel - the inventory includes it so the engine must discriminate.

Second-occupant / upgrade increment: event funds the business-equivalent single (285/night); double-occupancy delta and the companion seat are traveller-funded increments, and clauses.companionAndUpgradeIncrement gates execution on the explicit funding declaration present in the request.

Funded-window schema nuance: rule-ait-hotel-funded-window appliesTo place-hotel-bayview; Harbourline admissibility comes from clauses.accommodationCeiling preferredPlaces - surface this as a policy-interpretation fact, and the pack lists it as a schema gap rather than hardcoding it.

Event viability after hotel switch: deterministic morning-buffer check for the 1 Oct 10:30 dual interview using groundTransfers estimates (Harbourline->MBS 15m expected / 25m conservative, sound check 07:30-08:30, speaker-ready 60m lead); the switch must be rejected if buffers fail - here they pass with margin.
Local routing: arrival transfer re-routes Changi->Harbourline (same covered segment type, same expected duration); departure transfer unchanged (3 Oct, in-window).
No companion ontology: the partner stays a declared-cost fact on the traveller's request; the pack does not invent a draftId or traveller entity for them.
